objective: Record, as a filing rather than a start, that the proposal intake silently discards three filed records and silently downgrades a committed queue status, and that the function which keeps the refusals was built without any surface that shows them
rationale: MEASURED 2026-08-14 by invoking the intake reader directly and then asking it for its own refusals. The inbox holds 121 files. The reader returns 118. Three are refused and skipped: the item to restore the linear-solver options escape hatch in the adjoint toolchain, priced at 15 core minutes; the unsteady probe run for the backward-facing step family; and the screen of the toolchain's default relaxation factors across two case classes, priced at 26 core minutes. Two of the three are solver and numerics work, which is a well the lab is actively trying to fill. The refusal reasons are all style rails firing on internal file references and file paths inside citations, plus one hardness-floor value outside the closed list. A FOURTH FINDING SITS BESIDE THEM: two records carry a status word that is not in the reader's accepted set, so both are read as merely proposed. Those two are the airfoil and flat-plate verification ladders, together 807 core minutes of work somebody deliberately queued, and the queue marker does not survive being read. THE PART THAT MAKES THIS A CLASS RATHER THAN THREE BUGS: a function that returns every refused file with its violations DOES exist and was written in response to the stated principle that a filter nobody can see is a filter nobody can question. Searched across the tracked tree, its only callers are two assertions in the test suite. It is called by nothing that produces a surface a person reads. The defect was fixed as a function and never as a report, which is a distinct and repeatable failure shape: the remedy was implemented, tested, and left unwired. THE NULL, AND IT IS NOT FITTED: the reader's current behaviour, observed before any change. THE IDENTITY TEST, owner rule W dash 2: the quantity is the count of files the reader refuses, obtained by asking the reader. Could it be derived by construction from its own inputs? Partly, and the honest answer is that this is a self-report and is therefore checked against an external referent rather than trusted: the count of files on disk is obtained by listing the directory, which does not go through the reader at all, and the difference between 121 and 118 is what the refusal list must explain. It does, exactly, which is the check. WHY THIS IS A FILING AND NOT A START: repository and infrastructure work is gated behind the convergence of the current verification ladder. Nothing here is to be begun. It is written down so it is not rediscovered.
gate: NO WORK IS AUTHORISED BY THIS RECORD. It is a filing. What it asserts and what would falsify each assertion, so a later reader can check rather than believe. ONE: the reader returns 118 of 121 files. Falsified by invoking the reader and getting a different count, which will happen as soon as records are added or repaired, so the assertion is anchored to 2026-08-14 and to the repository head of that moment rather than stated in the present tense. TWO: the three named files are the refused ones, with the violation strings the reader itself produced. Falsified by a different refusal list. THREE: the two queued records read back as proposed. Falsified by the reader accepting the queue word. FOUR: the refusal-reporting function has no caller outside the test suite. Falsified by a caller, and the search frame is stated: the tracked tree, source and prose, using the system search rather than this shell's default, which honours ignore files and would have made a smaller answer look like the same answer. When the gate on infrastructure work lifts, the repair is three lines of judgement and not three lines of code: whether a style rail should refuse a whole record or name the offending phrase and pass the rest is a decision, and it is Katie's, not the fleet's.
cost_basis: ZERO solver compute and ZERO further agent cost, because the measurement is already spent: it cost 2 tool calls during the drafting of this proposal, which sits inside this lab's measured bounded-question band of 2 to 5 calls. The forecast for executing the filing is therefore zero rather than a guess, and it is scoreable in the sense that any nonzero measured cost falsifies it. The repair, when the gate lifts, is not priced here because its shape depends on a ruling that has not been made.
expected_knowledge_gain: THE DISCRIMINATING OUTCOME, and it has already partly fired: anyone reasoning about this lab's proposal corpus by counting files gets a different population than the docket sees, and three real items of planned work are outside every review that reads the docket. Belief moves on the general point rather than the three instances: this lab fixes defects by writing functions and has at least one measured case of a remedy that was implemented, tested and never wired to a surface, which is a shape worth looking for elsewhere. Belief would be unmoved if the refusals turned out to be intended and reported somewhere, and the stated search frame is what makes that checkable rather than assumed.
hard_criterion_note: Starts no flow case. A measurement of the intake reader's own behaviour against a directory listing taken outside it.
